The Structural Collapse of the Legacy B2B Marketing Playbook
Implications and Revenue Architecture for DSV
The legacy Playbook Has Created The “Digital Debt”
Lead gen, linear funnels, and demographic targeting no longer map to buyer reality.
Platform, funnel, buyer, and search crises are compounding efficiency loss.
Inflates CAC, corrupts data, and obscures true demand; threatens post‑Schenker agility.
Move from MQL volume to account‑level intent, governance, and buying‑group orchestration.

Why the Old Playbook Is Failing
Nine structural fractures in legacy lead generation
Taxonomy mismatch inflates CAC; premium CPMs for vanity titles and “sell‑to” vs “in‑industry” confusion wastes budget.
Impressions ≠ influence. Feed saturation and generic imagery trigger scroll‑by behavior.
Programmatic leakage drains budget and corrupts retargeting pools (algos optimize to bots).
Individuals ≠ accounts. Low‑intent form fills create “lead fatigue” and misaligned handoffs.
Off‑site research (peers, communities, podcasts) goes untracked; “Direct” is over‑credited.
Single‑threaded deals fail; targeting must include Finance, Sustainability, and Ops.
FOMU stalls consensus; “sense‑making” content is needed to reduce status‑quo risk.
AI answers in‑SERP; shift from SEO to Entity Authority to stay visible.
Gates block education; buyers choose vendors with ungated, self‑serve info.
The Nine Structural Fractures in the Legacy Model
A 3x3 overview of the core failure points and the directional shifts required
Job‑title targeting wastes spend; pivot to intent + firmographic fit.
Banner blindness drives low CTR; optimize for sense‑making and engagement density.
Invalid traffic drains budget and corrupts data; enforce inclusion lists and fraud controls.
Individuals ≠ accounts; inquiry‑to‑win < 1%. Shift to MQA (buying‑group signals).
Gates block education; 75% prefer rep‑free. Ungate early‑stage content.
70–90% of research is invisible; deanonymize to reveal surging accounts.
6–10 stakeholders; indecision risk. Provide decision‑support and sense‑making.
SEO wanes; build AEO + entity authority and prepare for AI‑agent buying.
Orphaned systems and fragmented data; unify a machine‑readable commercial layer.

Suspend audience networks by default; buy only on verified inventory.
Enable third‑party verification (pre‑bid/post‑bid); enforce platform allow‑lists.

Quarantine suspicious sessions from CRM; exclude from lookalikes/attribution.
